records.name: Wharton Undergraduate Aerospace Club
records.summary: A Penn undergraduate club for students who want aerospace and defense careers. Any Penn undergrad can come to general meetings, and committee members help run events such as a February 2026 symposium on regulating new space technology.
records.what_you_do: Attend general meetings, apply to a committee in the fall or spring to work on a project or event, and come to talks and symposiums the club co-sponsors.

first_step.how: Come to a general body meeting, which is open to any Penn undergraduate. Committee seats are filled by application in the fall or spring.
first_step.basis: General body meetings are open to any Penn undergraduate, though committee seats need an application.

records.notes: Directory status says INACTIVE, but the club's own site lists a February 2026 symposium it co-sponsored, and that outweighs the flag. The site also mentions a 2025 fireside chat and a 2022 award, which are too old to set the status. The directory lists no events.

records.name: Wharton-Weitzman Future of Cities Forum
records.summary: Penn graduate students who run an annual conference on how cities get built. The 2026 meeting, held in Philadelphia on February 20, 2026, brought together people working on housing, transit, climate and finance.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket for the yearly conference through its Eventbrite link, sign up for updates on the site, or look into the student research section. Tickets are sold online, so people outside Penn can attend.

schedule.text: One conference a year. The 2026 conference was on Friday, February 20, 2026.

locations.label: The Study at University City, Philadelphia (2026 conference venue)

cost.text: Tickets are sold online. The price was not in the text I read.

first_step.how: To attend, buy a ticket through the conference's Eventbrite link. The directory says joining the club takes an application, and the club site does not explain how to apply.
first_step.basis: The directory says an application is required, and the site does not explain how to join the student team.

records.notes: Directory status says INACTIVE, but the club's own site dates its 2026 conference to February 20, 2026, and that outweighs the flag. Directory says the club accepts members and requires an application. The directory email is hidden. Member emails in the directory belong to students and were not recorded.

notes: All 13 Penn clubs in the batch were checked: one directory fetch each (13 fetches) plus one fetch of each club's own website where the directory entry links one (10 fetches). Two clubs have full records based on dated 2026 items on their own sites: Wharton Undergraduate Aerospace Club (February 2026 symposium) and the Wharton-Weitzman Future of Cities Forum (conference on February 20, 2026). The other 11 are held back with status unknown. Items for the owner to decide: (1) Wharton Undergraduates in Public Policy: the directory says applications re-open in Fall 2026, but the club site does not confirm it, so it is held back. (2) Wharton Women: the directory mentions a 2026 award that the site does not show, so it is held back. (3) Wharton Undergraduate Sports Business Club: newest dated item is Fall 2024, about two years old, so it is held back. (4) Wharton Undergraduate Consulting Club: only the home page was fetched; /events and /joinus may hold fall 2026 recruiting. (5) Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club: its website returned HTTP 404 (not a block). No WebSearch was used and no pages were blocked. Individual student emails, co-president emails and roster emails from the directory were not recorded.
